parser_family: sqllens ANTLR4 grammars (generated dist/generated/<dialect>/*Parser.js on the antlr4ng runtime); its PostgreSQL grammar is a fork of the antlr/grammars-v4 PostgreSQL grammar. Independent of node-sql-parser, pgsql-ast-parser, sql-parser-cst, sqlite-parser and libpg_query; dt-sql-parser is a separate ANTLR4 package whose selected MySQL grammar is a different grammar
api: parse(local UTF-8 text, 'postgres') from sqllens -> {ast, errors, cst}; the summary is read from the documented cst (full ANTLR4 parse tree)
coverage: Node V8 block coverage mapped to source lines of sqllens/dist/**/*.js (the generated ANTLR4 PostgreSQL parser and lexer and the package's parse and lowering code) during valid-control replay; the antlr4ng runtime is a separate package and is not counted; Jazzer.js instrumentation for the fuzz entry
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes decoded as strict UTF-8 and passed to sqllens parse with the postgres dialect; a nonzero syntax-error count rejects the input. The summary is read from the returned CST, because the lowered IR marks INSERT as unsupported. Valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. Other dialects, analysis, lineage and templating are untested.
